==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am allied with superheroes and cartoon characters brought to life. Our base is a massive, cylindrical tower. It is very futuristic.

We deploy into battle by jumping into metal chutes. The chutes connect to a system of elevators that take us to enemy territory. I am not very helpful on the front lines.

My role is changed to sabotage. I am equipped with spy gear and smoke pellets. Here I thrive as our enemy's worst nightmare.
